text: みさきの　いえに　すんでいる　ばあさんさ…　いつも　ひとの　ポケモンを　じろじろ　みてきて　こわいんだよな

structure.jp: みさきの　いえに　すんでいる　ばあさんさ…
structure.en: the old lady who lives in the house on the cape, you know...

structure.jp: いつも　ひとの　ポケモンを　じろじろ　みてきて
structure.en: she's always staring at people's Pokémon, and

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: みさきの　いえに　すんでいる　ばあさん
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which one, like 'who' or 'that' in English. みさきの いえに すんでいる ばあさん = 'the old lady who lives in the house on the cape'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form says the action comes toward the speaker's side. じろじろ みてきて = 'she stares over at us'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone. こわいんだよな = 'it's scary, you know'.
